name: boo
description: A Claude-native planning agent. Produces evidence-grounded briefings — a personal 'Your day ahead' from Google Workspace, and role-based team briefs for product teams across GitHub, Slack, Google/Microsoft 365, Linear/Jira, PagerDuty, Sentry and more. Delivered inside Claude, drafts/preview only (never sends or posts autonomously), with explicit approval before any change.
